1._section_summary: This abstract reports a single study of 509 men from the community in London, UK who completed measures including drive for muscularity, body appreciation, the Big Five personality domains, and subjective social status. Regression analyses (controlling for BMI and subjective social status) found that body appreciation was negatively predicted by Neuroticism and positively by Extraversion; drive for muscularity was predicted by Neuroticism.
